reviewer: Pickle: official-source winter office desk heating, 18 C public-office rule, lower-body thermal comfort, partition heater vs PTC fan vs heated desk pad electricity cost and fire data
method: Reviewed the draft against 15 sources on 2026-11-11. Indoor temperature rule: the official text of 「공공기관 에너지이용 합리화 추진에 관한 규정」 (산업통상자원부 고시 제2024-110호, PDF read directly) Article 14(1) requires public institutions to keep average indoor temperature at or below 18 C when heating and at or above 28 C when cooling, and Article 14(3) forbids personal heaters during working hours (09:00-18:00) except for approved cases such as pregnant workers, disabled workers and staff in unheated areas. The 2026-11-04 Herald Business report on the current 기후에너지환경부 고시 제2026-111호 confirms the same 18 C ceiling, sets the household recommendation at 20 C, states a 1 C reduction cuts energy use about 7%, and notes that the WHO Housing and Health Guidelines 18 C is a floor, not a ceiling. Office environment: KOSHA GUIDE E-G-6-2025 section 4.3 requires 18-24 C and 40-70 %RH in offices with central air handling. Thermal comfort: ASHRAE 55 clause 5.3.4 limits the head (1.1 m) to ankle (0.1 m) air temperature difference to 3 C for seated occupants; Liu et al. 2020 (Energy and Buildings, 98 seated subjects, gradients 0.4-8.4 C/m) found cold-feet complaints outnumber warm-head complaints and whole-body dissatisfaction stays under 10 % even at 8.4 C/m; the Tochihara 2023 review (JJHE 25:47) reports the preferred lower-body temperature is 1.3-6.0 C higher than the upper body; the 2015 SHASE conference paper ran 18 combinations of upper-body 20/22/24 C, lower-body 18-26 C and floor 16-30 C with 4 seated subjects and 72 trials; 정근주·오근숙 2012 (AIK) measured PMV about -1.0 at 18 C and a 1.6 C rise in sole skin temperature from heated insoles without any change in whole-body thermal sensation. Fire: 행정안전부 / 소방청 국가화재정보시스템 2018-2022 give 2,390 electric-heating appliance fires, 1,211 electric stoves, 1,179 electric blankets, 344 casualties (48 deaths, 296 injuries), 994 fires (42 %) in December and January, causes 45 % carelessness, 31 % electrical, 19 % mechanical; the 2021 소방청 release gives 4,546 winter heating-product fires over 2016-2020 (909 a year) with 1,956 (43.0 %) from electric blankets and heaters. Electricity: KEPCO residential low-voltage tariff (2023-11-09 schedule, unchanged as of 2026-10) 120.0 / 214.6 / 307.3 won per kWh with basic charges 910 / 1,600 / 7,300 won, plus climate 9.0 won, 2026 Q4 fuel adjustment +5.0 won, VAT 10 % and the 2.7 % industry fund. All cost figures were computed from those rates by comparing the monthly bill at a 250 kWh baseline (44,883 won) with the bill after adding the device load, not by multiplying a single unit price: 165 W at 8 h for 20 days = 26.4 kWh = +6,799 won, 400 W = 64 kWh = +16,493 won, 1,000 W = 160 kWh = +48,693 won, 1,500 W = 240 kWh = +77,658 won; 1,500 W at 4 h = 120 kWh = +30,915 won; 165 W at 8 h for 30 days = 39.6 kWh gives +5,987 won in a 150 kWh household, +10,198 won at 250 kWh and +14,346 won at 450 kWh, which is why the article says the same device can cost more than double depending on the household's tier. I deliberately corrected two widely repeated brief figures rather than repeat them: a 150 W-class partition heater at 8 h a day cannot cost 1,500-2,500 won a month (the cheapest first-tier calculation is already 5,987 won), and an 800-1,200 W fan heater at 8 h a day costs far more than the commonly quoted 30,000-50,000 won, because 1,500 W at 8 h for 20 days already adds 77,658 won. Products checked on Coupang on 2026-11-11: 듀플렉스 접이식 워머박스 파티션히터 DP-PH70X, 165 W, 38,250 won (list 146,000), 1,277 reviews, KC HU072530-20006A-1; 신일 PTC 온풍 팬히터 SEH-P1600WS, 1,500 W, 63,900 won, 1,223 reviews, KC HU071204-18010, energy label estimated monthly cost 143,000 won and 660 g CO2/h; HULULU 3단 온열조절 데스크 전기 매트 80x32 cm, 29,500 won, 638 reviews, timer, KC SU072723-21002B, and no wattage declared on the page, which the article states openly instead of inventing a figure. The brief's first pick '보국 프리미엄 4면 접이식 파티션 데스크 히터' does not exist: a Coupang search for 보국 파티션 히터 returns only 보국전자 quartz and fan heaters, no partition product, so the ranking uses the 듀플렉스 box-type unit that actually carries a 165 W declaration and a top cover. Kakao Gift curator links are reused live links (12crFPXn 카르닉 후드 넥워머, 9rNUCeSC 오아 무선 미니 가습기) because the curator dashboard still blocks on a DKAPTCHA challenge, and the article tells readers that the 10,000-20,000 won gift band is the warmer/pad band rather than the partition heater. Verified no 진단/치료/처방/복용법/부작용 wording in title, description, targetQuery, secondaryQueries or tags, all tildes converted to en dashes so no stray strikethrough renders, and that every product statement matches the seller page. Because an existing guide (desk-foot-warmer-partition-heater-types-electricity-guide, 2026-10-29) already compared partition heater, desk pad and carbon mini heater, the angle here was changed to the 18 C public-office rule, lower-body thermal comfort science, tier-dependent billing and gift framing; measured overlap with that post is 24 % body, 23 % title, 33 % query.
